purpose: Aspect attribute configurations (AspectFunction.java:811-838, DependencyResolutionHelpers.java:195-253, DependencyProducer.java:184-219): every label attribute of an aspect is configured per application by its own cfg - the base target's configuration for cfg='target', the exec transition for the ASPECT's execution platform for cfg='exec'/config.exec() (k8-opt-exec), a Starlark transition applied to the base configuration (k8-fastbuild-ST-..., also on top of an exec-configured base: k8-opt-exec-ST-...); a Starlark-transitioned label attribute is a list in ctx.attr; config.exec('nope') of an undeclared group fails at the base target; the aspect context's configuration surface (ctx.bin_dir, ctx.var) is the base target's configuration (k8-opt-exec/opt for an exec-configured base).

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; one fresh copy of tests/fixtures/aspect_configuration/workspace per case

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy. prints: the print() lines carrying the case's marker, genuine's `DEBUG: <file>:<line>:<col>: ` prefix removed, sorted. outputs: every file below bazel-out whose name ends with one of the case's suffixes, by path below bazel-out (genuine: the bazel-out convenience symlink; native: the published action outputs), with its contents. errors: genuine's ERROR lines; native's stderr without the memory-limit notice.
comparison: MATCH = equal exit code, prints and outputs, and for a failing case genuine's first error message (location removed) appears in a native error line.
